card.name: Dates and names in Chinese history
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and small words inside dates and titles in passages about Chinese history, art and traditional medicine. Examples are year digits like 1050 or 1101–25, and the gap between a month and a day.

modes.label: Digits in dates
modes.description: A digit or space inside a year or date, in text about Chinese dynasties or history.

modes.label: Words in Chinese titles
